hints.title: Out Of Order Boundary Scan
hints.text: Elements that violate sorted order are either smaller than some preceding element or larger than some subsequent element. How can extremes define the boundaries?

hints.title: Bidirectional Extremum Invariant
hints.text: Moving left to right, any element smaller than the maximum seen so far must be sorted. Moving right to left, any element larger than the minimum seen so far must be sorted.

hints.title: Extremum Tracking Range Determination Procedure
hints.text: Scan from left to right tracking the maximum value; mark the last index where the current element is less than that maximum. Scan from right to left tracking the minimum value; mark the first index where the element exceeds that minimum. If no inversion exists, return zero; otherwise return the span.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cloning and sorting the array takes O(N log N) time and consumes O(N) additional memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking prefix maximums and suffix minimums in a single or dual linear pass solves the problem in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should provide the O(1) space two-pointer / running extremum approach and explain why end - start + 1 captures the minimal window.
